traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation gives opposite leaves, but Schisandraceae (about 90 spp., most of the order) has spiral leaves; Austrobaileyaceae and Trimeniaceae opposite. Weighted by species.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): Schisandraceae spiral (two-ranked in Schisandreae, crowded pseudo-whorls in Illicium); other families opposite.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): blades undivided, entire or toothed.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): lianas, shrubs and trees.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): woody climbers and trees; Illicium leaves crowded at shoot tips (Schisandraceae already states this).

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): Austrobaileya flowers single, axillary, pendulous; Schisandraceae flowers single or few in axils (our reading); Trimeniaceae branched inflorescences.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers axillary in Austrobaileyaceae and Trimeniaceae (rarely terminal); axillary in Schisandraceae.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): perianth, stamens and carpels spiral; flowers radial.

traits.perianth.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation: perianth spiral.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): free parts on a receptacle; no hypanthium described.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): free carpels on the receptacle.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Austrobaileyales page (read 2026-10-16): berrylets (Schisandreae, Austrobaileya); Illicium a star of explosive follicles.
